source.title: A message and a notice (ladder unit, machine-drafted)
source.author: Go course authors (drafted by an AI model)
source.attribution: Course-authored controlled German. Drafted by an AI model; not yet reviewed by a native speaker.
source.provenance: Drafted by an AI model for the course ladder; not reviewed by a native speaker. It is controlled, deliberately repetitive German written for learners and may contain unnatural phrasing. The English lines are the drafter's own.
source.licenseNote: Owned by the course authors; machine-drafted, not yet native-reviewed.

review.notes: Machine-drafted by an AI model; awaiting native-speaker review. Short written messages (du among friends) and a notice on the church. The weekdays are written with "am" (am Montag). "Doch" is the answer to a negative question ("Hast du keine Klasse? - Doch!") and a particle in "Kommt doch!". The notice uses the imperative ("Kommt alle!"). The times of the notice are examples, not a real programme.

english.source: drafted with the text; not reviewed

sentences.text: Er hat eine Nachricht von Thomas.
sentences.english: He has a message from Thomas.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Am Samstag ist Frühstück in der Gemeinde.
sentences.english: On Saturday there is breakfast at the church.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.english: On Friday I am cooking soup.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Ich bin Pastor, das ist mein Beruf.
sentences.english: I am a pastor, that is my job.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Herr Schmidt ist Bäcker, und er ist Chef.
sentences.english: Herr Schmidt is a baker, and he is the boss.

sentences.speaker: thomas
sentences.text: Das Wetter ist warm, dann essen wir im Park.
sentences.english: The weather is warm, then we eat in the park.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Am Freitag habe ich einen Termin.
sentences.english: On Friday I have an appointment.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Aber am Samstag komme ich gern.
sentences.english: But on Saturday I will gladly come.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.english: Yes I can, I will come in the evening.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Hast du am Montag und am Dienstag Klasse?
sentences.english: Do you have class on Monday and Tuesday?

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Ich bin Krankenschwester, ich arbeite immer am Montag und am Dienstag.
sentences.english: I am a nurse, I always work on Monday and Tuesday.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Am Mittwoch habe ich einen Termin beim Arzt.
sentences.english: On Wednesday I have an appointment with the doctor.

sentences.speaker: anna
sentences.text: Der Arzt ist ein guter Mann, ich bin gesund.
sentences.english: The doctor is a good man, I am well.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Am Montag und am Dienstag habe ich Klasse.
sentences.english: On Monday and Tuesday I have class.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Am Mittwoch habe ich einen Termin in der Schule.
sentences.english: On Wednesday I have an appointment at the school.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Soll ich dich am Donnerstag anrufen?
sentences.english: Shall I call you on Thursday?

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Doch, aber am Abend bin ich wieder zu Hause.
sentences.english: Yes I do, but in the evening I am at home again.

sentences.text: Daniel ist ein Freund aus den USA.
sentences.english: Daniel is a friend from the USA.

sentences.text: Er spricht nicht gut Deutsch, aber er lernt gern.
sentences.english: He does not speak German well, but he likes learning.

sentences.text: Daniel kommt am Donnerstag mit dem Zug an.
sentences.english: Daniel is arriving by train on Thursday.
Sam has to go to the station.

sentences.text: Die Haltestelle ist in der Straße.
sentences.english: The stop is in the street.

sentences.text: Die Straßenbahn kommt in fünf Minuten.
sentences.english: The tram comes in five minutes.

sentences.text: An der Kirche ist eine Nachricht für die Gemeinde.
sentences.english: At the church there is a notice for the congregation.
Saturday, 9 a.m.: breakfast in the park.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Die Sonne ist warm, und es ist nicht kalt.
sentences.english: The sun is warm, and it is not cold.

sentences.speaker: sam
sentences.text: Dann sind wir wieder in der Gemeinde.
sentences.english: Then we are back in the church again.
